heroDescription: We survey and plan our plots before we sell them. Access roads, drainage and marked boundaries come first. Every plot is published with GPS coordinates. Check the location yourself, from Kampala or from abroad.
verificationHeading: See the land before you pay for it.
verificationIntro: The biggest risk in buying land in Uganda is buying blind. We remove that risk, for our plots and for anyone else's.

verificationSteps.title: Tell us the plot
verificationSteps.text: Send us the plot you want on WhatsApp. It can be one of ours or land you found elsewhere.

verificationSteps.title: We walk the land
verificationSteps.text: Our team visits the site. We check the boundaries and photograph what is there.

verificationSteps.title: You get the evidence
verificationSteps.text: GPS coordinates, satellite view and a dated photo report, sent straight to your phone.

verificationSteps.title: You decide
verificationSteps.text: The report is yours. Buy with confidence or walk away. It does its job either way.

invitationHeading: Ask us to walk any plot in Uganda.
invitationText: Buying from abroad? This service exists for you.
weaverParagraph1: Our logo is a weaver bird for a reason. The weaver builds its nest knot by knot. Then the nest is inspected, pulled at and tested before it is accepted. Weak work gets rejected, torn down and rebuilt.
weaverParagraph2: That is how we treat land. We plan it, mark it and document it to survive inspection. Yours, your family's, your surveyor's.
